conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Brian from the Amazon Account Security Team. Is this Mrs. Parker? I'm calling regarding a recent attempt to purchase a PlayStation 5 on your Amazon account.
Oh my, I wasn't aware of any PlayStation purchase. Is there an issue with my account?

Yes, ma'am. We noticed an attempt to purchase high-value electronics. For your protection, we've temporarily put your account on hold. Has anyone else in your family used your Amazon account recently?
My daughter sometimes uses my account to buy books, but she wouldn't buy a PlayStation. What do I need to do?
Thank you for letting me know. To confirm your identity and secure your account, I need to verify a few details. Can you please confirm the email address associated with your Amazon?
Sure, it's parkerkaren@gmail.com.
Thank you, Mrs. Parker. I also need to confirm your current mailing address on file to ensure we're speaking to the rightful account holder.
It's 412 Oak Lane, Springfield.
That's perfect. Let me check our system. Okay, I see that the suspicious purchase was attempted late last night. For your security, may I ask if you recognize the device ending in 3021?
No, I don't know that device. Should I be worried?

No need to panic. This happens sometimes if login details are compromised. We're here to help. To proceed, I need you to log in to your Amazon account on your device so we can complete the security check together.
Okay, I'm logging in now.
Thank you. You should see a notification about a hold on your account. Did you receive it?
Yes, there's a message that says my account is temporarily locked for verification.
That's correct. To restore access, I need you to reset your password. I'll stay on the line for your assistance. Let me know when you've done that, please.
I've changed the password.
Excellent. Now, to ensure no unauthorized payment methods have been added, could you check your payment options and confirm the last four digits of your saved card?
I just see my Visa ending in 1124.

Thank you, that matches our records. Now, to reverse the pending charge for the PlayStation, our finance system requires a temporary verification deposit. This process is standard and fully refundable.
A deposit? How does that work?

We'll need you to purchase Amazon gift cards totaling the pending amount, which is $499. Once you provide the gift card codes, the system will cancel the unauthorized order and refund the amount directly to your payment method. This is a secure and verified process.
So I have to buy $499 in gift cards? That seems odd.

I completely understand your concern, Mrs. Parker. This procedure is only temporary and designed to prevent fraudulent withdrawals. As soon as you provide the codes, the amount will be credited back to you. We've helped many customers this way.
Alright, if this is what I need to do to protect my account, I'll get the cards.
Thank you for your cooperation. Please let me know once you have the cards, and I will assist you with the next steps.
I'm at the store now. I bought five $100 Amazon gift cards.
Great, Mrs. Parker. Please read each gift card code to me carefully so I can enter them into our verification system.
Okay, the first code is XJ9P-47G2-1LQ8...
Thank you. Can you read the next code, please?
The second is K3MT-29WQ-7U6D.
Thank you, I have entered it. Please continue with the next three codes.
Here they are: Q8N5-L4VZ-2R3X, RA7Z-8PKB-0C1Y, and S5H2-M6B8-9F4V.
All codes have been received. The system confirms your account is now safe and the unauthorized order has been cancelled. The $499 will be refunded to your original payment method within 24 hours.
Thank you. I was really worried about losing money.
You did the right thing by acting quickly. If you receive any further notifications, please contact us on this number immediately. Your security is our top priority.
